s1.h: Typed in the wrong keyboard language?
s1.s: Select the text and press Ctrl + Q. It’s fixed in place, instantly.

s2.h: Every key goes back to the letter you meant
s2.s: KeyFlip knows which keys you pressed and rewrites them in your other language.

s4.s: The B key types لا — exactly like G then H. KeyFlip picks the right word and only asks when it can’t be sure.

s5.h: Your text never leaves your device
s5.s: Fully private, with the time you save in plain view.
